domain: epistemology of note taking

# Schema

This vault declares no vocabulary. Not an empty one — none at all: no `tags`, no
`required_fields`, no `types`, no `statuses`, no `confidences`, no `verbs`.

That is the fixture's whole input. A vault that has never heard of this skill looks exactly
like this, and the linter must not have an opinion about what its notes should have said.
